description: Native WDL objective smoke. Re-run the best low-bucket SF-binpack scratch shape with Bullet WDL mixing enabled instead of the previous CP-only objective.

metadata.hypothesis: The previous native Bullet SF-binpack smokes used bullet_wdl=0.0. A WDL-aware objective is a proven NNUE recipe and may reduce scalar CP overfitting while keeping the 1-bucket feature geometry that gave the best low-data signal.
metadata.init: scratch quantized Bullet init; no Berserk initialization
metadata.architecture: 1 training input bucket expanded to the 32-bucket Enyo runtime layout on export; hidden=1024, l2=16
metadata.one_variable: Change bullet_wdl from 0.0 to 0.75 relative to native-bullet-enyo1-sfbinpack-smoke-eval400-lr1e3-sb2048.
metadata.gate: After checkpoint sweep, require clear improvement over the previous 1-bucket smoke on the 800-target external gate before any longer run. No SPRT unless broad/mate-like tails are sane.

validation.checkpoint_sweep: Run checkpoints 512,1024,1536,2048 against the 800-target Lichess policy/search gate and compare to native-bullet-enyo1-sfbinpack-smoke-eval400-lr1e3-sb2048.
validation.promotion: Not eligible for SPRT unless candidate_better approaches reference_better, capped_sum_diff_cp improves materially, and mate-like worst regression is no longer catastrophic.
validation.next: If WDL is not clearly better than CP-only, stop this objective branch and move to larger/better data rather than retuning the same shape.
